_: The asset style: technique prompts (no plot) for cut-outs, backdrops, silhouettes and textures + the light and paper material on the stage. Descriptions of characters and places live in bible.json, style-free.
cutout: A single hand-made paper cut-out puppet for a children's toy theatre: drawn and painted by hand with gouache and colored pencils on thin matte cardboard, slightly naive but precise and expressive drawing, visible pencil hatching and dry-brush texture, muted early-1900s palette (ochre, umber, faded olive green, dusty rose, ink black, warm paper white). The figure is cut out with scissors, leaving a narrow, slightly uneven white paper margin around the whole silhouette. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, the whole figure fully visible, nothing cropped.
cutout_bg: Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-green (#00FF00) background with no texture, no gradient and no shadow; the green touches only the white paper margin.
backdrop: A painted cardboard backdrop for a children's toy theatre: gouache and colored pencil on matte cardboard, slightly naive hand-made look, visible brush strokes and paper grain, flat frontal view, perspective drawn simply by hand, muted early-1900s palette, soft even lighting, no people.
silhouette: A single solid black paper silhouette cut-out in the tradition of Lotte Reiniger shadow puppets: intricate scissor-cut details (lace, plumes, fingers, hair), crisp edges, pure matte black with no interior detail, isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-green (#00FF00) background.
texture: A seamless flat texture, top-down, evenly lit, hand-painted with gouache on matte paper, no objects, no perspective, no shadows.
no_text: No text, no letters, no captions, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame.
